text: Coding agent auto-detects and installs toolchains/dependencies needed for a task
quote: Linear detects and installs the toolchains and dependencies it needs to complete the task.

text: Agent opens the app, navigates a flow, and verifies its implementation with before/after screenshots
quote: The agent opens the app, navigates through a flow, and verifies its implementation. It also captures before-and-after screenshots

text: Admins can set workspace-wide and per-user spend limits resetting daily, weekly, or monthly
quote: Admins can also set workspace-wide and per-user spend limits that reset daily, weekly, or monthly.

text: You can assign a team to lead an initiative to clarify ownership
quote: You can now assign a team to lead an initiative, making it clear who is responsible for driving the work and how it contributes to the broader direction.

text: Identity verified via Okta with existing Linear permissions applied, centrally managed by admins
quote: Linear verifies their identity through Okta and applies their existing Linear permissions. Admins can manage access centrally

text: Mobile app lets you review agent code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with the agent
quote: Use the Linear mobile app to review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent.

text: Guided Reviews split diffs into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
quote: Guided Reviews break diffs into focused sections with explainers on what changed and why.

text: Reviews can be assigned to GitHub teams, appearing in a dedicated inbox section
quote: You can now assign reviews to GitHub teams. Review requests assigned to your GitHub teams appear in a dedicated section of the Reviews inbox.

text: Coding sessions support signed commits via SSH or GPG key added in Settings
quote: Coding sessions now support signed commits. Add your SSH or GPG key in Settings to enable signing.

text: GitHub Copilot users can assign issues directly to Copilot's cloud agent from Linear
quote: GitHub Copilot users can assign issues directly to Copilot’s cloud agent from Linear.

text: Loops let you describe a recurring job in plain language and run it on a schedule or event trigger
quote: Loops are a new way for Linear Agent to take on recurring work for your team. Describe the job in plain language and then choose whether it should run on a schedule or in response to an event.

text: Linear Agent can edit text and use Loops to keep docs/project descriptions updated, with author indicators showing human vs loop edits
quote: You can now edit text with Linear Agent, and use Loops to keep docs and project descriptions up-to-date. Author name indicators let you check if text was written by a colleague or added by a loop.

text: Any filtered view can be shared via a copyable URL or keyboard shortcut
quote: You can now share any filtered view by copying its URL from your browser, or by pressing ⌘/Ctrl Shift C on desktop.

text: Proposed and canceled statuses plus priority indicate initiative consideration state and importance
quote: Proposed and canceled statuses make it clear when an initiative is under consideration or has been intentionally set aside... Priority communicates which initiatives are most important

text: Private sub-teams let groups like skunkworks or sensitive-data teams organize under one umbrella
quote: Private sub-teams organize groups that work together under one umbrella, like independent business units, skunkworks efforts, or teams handling sensitive data

text: Custom agents can be built to investigate incidents, monitor SLAs, or analyze customer feedback
quote: Build agents that can investigate incidents, monitor SLAs, or analyze customer feedback.

text: Pipeline settings can auto-generate release notes so changelog stays current
quote: Choose to auto-generate release notes in pipeline settings so your changelog is always up to date.

text: URL parameters can pre-fill the Create OAuth App form, and a JSON manifest format supports local validation or programmatic generation
quote: Use URL parameters to send users directly to a pre-filled Create OAuth App form in Linear. An equivalent JSON manifest format lets you store configurations in files, validate them locally, or generate them programmatically.

text: Write with Agent auto-generates status update drafts by reviewing changes and linked Slack messages
quote: Instead of finding that context manually, click Write with Agent to let Linear do it for you. The agent reviews changes made since the last update, checks messages in the linked Slack channel, and writes an update draft for you to refine.

text: Pinned tabs stay anchored in the tab bar and persist across app restarts
quote: Pinned tabs are now a reliable home for important work. They stay anchored in the tab bar, persist after quitting and reopening the app, and aren’t replaced by new content you open.

text: Linear Agent can write code using Claude Code and Codex, enabling triage, plan, review, and ship all in Linear
quote: Linear Agent can now write code using Claude Code and Codex. You can triage, plan, review, and ship—all in Linear.

text: Documents can be created from team home pages, added from projects/issues, and grouped into sections
quote: Teams can create documents directly from their home page, add existing documents from projects and issues, and group resources into sections.

text: Skills can be shared with a team to standardize recurring workflows like specs or planning
quote: We now support sharing skills with your team so great personal workflows can become shared team process.

text: Users can comment directly on text or images in issue descriptions
quote: You can now comment directly on text or images in issue descriptions.

text: Linear Agent can set up, run, and test code before returning its work
quote: Linear Agent can now set up, run, and test your code before returning its work.

text: Initiatives led by private teams are only visible to team members, supporting confidential planning
quote: initiatives led by private teams are only visible to team members. This creates a secure place for confidential planning, regulated projects, audits

text: Admins can manage employee access centrally without requiring individual sign-in/authorization
quote: Admins can manage access centrally, without requiring employees to sign in or authorize Linear individually.

text: My Issues → Assigned shows a delegated-issues section with coding session status for quick access
quote: We’ve also added section under My Issues → Assigned for your delegated issues. It shows the status of each coding session, and gives you a quick way back into active work.

text: Sub-teams can be restricted to parent team members or fully private except to invited members
quote: Restricted to parent team members — parent team members can see and choose to join the sub-team... Private to team members — the team is hidden, except to members directly invited to that sub-team

text: Teammates can delegate issues to a connected agent or mention it in comments
quote: Once connected to Linear, teammates can delegate issues to your agent or mention it in comments.

text: Coding sessions run in the cloud, requiring no local dev environment setup
quote: Coding sessions run in the cloud, so you can prototype ideas and make changes without setting up a local development environment.

text: On new issue report, Linear Agent can investigate and attempt a fix before it reaches an engineer
quote: When a new issue is reported, Linear Agent can investigate and attempt a fix before it reaches an engineer, reducing the load on your team.

text: Data can be imported from other services into Linear
quote: Import data from other services into Linear

text: Issue creation supports pre-filled fields via URL
quote: Open issue creation with pre-filled fields from a URL

text: Public API is built using GraphQL, the same API used internally
quote: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL. It's the same API we use internally for developing our applications.

text: API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication
quote: The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.

text: Webhooks deliver HTTP push notifications when data is created, updated, or removed
quote: Linear provides webhooks which allow you to receive HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed.

text: Webhooks can be created via the webhookCreate mutation scoped to a team or all public teams
quote: call the webhookCreate mutation with the teamId (or allPublicTeams: true) and url of your webhook

text: Official TypeScript SDK exposes the GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations
quote: The Linear Typescript SDK exposes the Linear GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations.

text: Agents behave like users: can be @mentioned, assigned via delegation, comment, and collaborate on projects/docs
quote: Agents behave similar to other users in a workspace. They can be @mentioned, delegated issues through assignment, create and reply to comments, collaborate on projects and documents, etc.

text: Assigning an issue to an app sets it as delegate rather than assignee, keeping humans as owners
quote: Assigning an issue to your app now sets it as the delegate, not the assignee—so humans maintain ownership while agents act on their behalf.

text: Teams can pin runtime versions, add setup scripts, and define environment variables for agent sessions
quote: Teams can go further by pinning runtime versions, adding setup scripts, and defining environment variables.

text: Linear Agent tests its work in the browser once the application is running
quote: Once the application is running, Linear Agent tests its work where users experience it: in the browser.

text: GitHub-synced issues can be opened directly in GitHub
quote: Open a GitHub-synced issue in GitHub with OG

text: MCP support for managing employee access through existing Okta-managed identity
quote: Linear's MCP now supports managing employee access through your existing Okta-managed identity.

text: You can subscribe to events in project views and get notifications in Inbox or Slack
quote: Added ability to subscribe to events in project views and receive notifications in Inbox or Slack

text: Conversations and customer feedback are automatically converted into routed, labeled, prioritized issues
quote: Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.

text: Teams can align around initiatives, strategic roadmaps, and up-to-date PRDs
quote: Align your team with product initiatives, strategic roadmaps, and clear, up-to-date PRDs.

text: Agents can be submitted to Linear's integration directory to be available to other workspaces
quote: To make your agent available to other workspaces, submit your agent to Linear's integration directory.

text: You can restore a coding session to any previous checkpoint in version history
quote: If you need to revert to an earlier version, restore to any previous checkpoint from version history.
